# Racing tips. ARS shows one through the help box after an apex you pass.
# One tip per line. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# A leading tag limits when a tip may appear; leave the tag off to allow it in any race:
#   [circuit]     circuit races only (not point to point)
#   [nitro]       only while racers are allowed nitrous
#   [tuning-off]  only while Auto Styling is off
# The chance per apex is the Racing Tips setting: High 1 in 10, Medium 1 in 20, Low 1 in 30.
[nitro] ARS hands you a fresh nitrous bottle every lap - spend the one you have.
[nitro] Racers can fire nitrous too - one shot a lap, on the straights.
[nitro] ARS manages nitrous for you if you enable it. Disable the one in your trainer or car tuning slot.
Play with the AI settings - there is a lot to adjust to your liking.
You can create specific car rosters creating more vehicle.txt lists in the Vehicles folder.
A Rival hounding you will eventually dive down the inside. Cover the line or leave room.
Adjust the difficulty in  Race Rules, or Race > PI settings.
The car roster is grouped by a Performance Index to ensure a somewhat even grid.
Rivals > Car Roster swaps which Vehicles roster the grid is drawn from.
You can record your own route: ARS > Track Creator, then Save Track.
[tuning-off] Auto Styling picks liveries, body kits and paint for the grid before a race.
For the best experience, pick up a handling mod. ARS can take it.
Remember to bring feedback to the author from time to time.
